title: Tiled Flash Attention
prompt: Implement an educational tiled online-softmax attention kernel for one causal head Q,K,V(N,D), with 1<=D<=128. Each thread handles one query and streams key tiles, avoiding an N-by-N score matrix. This emphasizes the FlashAttention recurrence, not production throughput.
subsection_title: CUDA reductions and fused ML kernels
